name: K'rrik, Son of Yawgmoth
oracle_text:
({B/P} can be paid with either {B} or 2 life.)
Lifelink
For each {B} in a cost, you may pay 2 life rather than pay that mana.
Whenever you cast a black spell, put a +1/+1 counter on K'rrik.
blocked_sentences: For each {B} in a cost, you may pay 2 life rather than pay that mana.

needs.what: a player-wide static (affects_player: you) under which every {B} symbol in any cost its controller pays -- spell mana costs, additional/alternative costs, and activated ability costs, including mana abilities -- may be paid with 2 life instead, i.e. each {B} pip is treated as {B/P} while the permanent is on the battlefield; the cast/activate line must offer the per-pip life choice (1..N pips) the way phyrexian mana does
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Phyrexian mana is supported only for {X/P} pips printed in a card's own mana cost (and not in activated ability costs, per completed-features). `pay_life_instead` exists only on the cast_from_library_top static (Bolas's Citadel), which pays a whole spell's mana value in life for cards on top of the library, not per-{B}-pip for any cost from any zone. spell_cost_reduction reduces generic mana and cannot convert a coloured pip into a life payment.
